title: Disclosure Authorization Receipt v1
description: Narrow-scoped temporary disclosure authorization receipt. Binds authorization to a specific evidence digest and disclosure class. Supports single-use and bounded-use consumption with integrity protection. Lane A owns this generic authority substrate; Lane B consumes it for Git-specific disclosure.

authorization_id.description: Stable authorization identifier — used as the persistent file key.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of receipt creation.

evidence_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the opaque evidence object this authorization binds to.

disclosure_class.description: Narrow-scoped disclosure class. raw_content and commit_patch are restricted by default policy.

requested_selector.description: Optional pseudonymous selector or target identity within the evidence object.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the receipt is invalid.

one_time.description: True for single-use receipts, False for bounded-use.

max_uses.description: Maximum uses for bounded-use receipts (ignored when one_time=True).

use_count.description: Current use count for bounded-use receipts.

consumed.description: True when a one-time receipt has been consumed.

receipt_sha256.description: Integrity digest covering all receipt data (excluding this field).
